description: Estimate the number of LLM tokens for one or more files or directories without returning their contents. Uses bytes/4 as a rough proxy.

paths.description: list of file or directory paths relative to the workspace root

name: count_tokens

description: Delete an inclusive range of 1-based lines from a file.

path.description: path to the file, relative to the workspace root

name: delete_lines

description: Delete a file or directory inside the workspace. Use recursive=true to remove non-empty directories. Refuses to delete workspace root.

path.description: file or directory path to delete, relative to workspace root

recursive.description: if true and target is a directory, deletes entire directory tree

name: delete_path

description: Download a file (text or binary, e.g. images) from an https URL and save it in the workspace. Use this for binary files that write_file cannot create. Limits: https only, any public host, max 20 MiB. Loopback and private network addresses are refused. The write is atomic: on any error (size limit, sha256 mismatch, existing file without overwrite) nothing is written. Returns the relative path, bytes written, sha256 and the reported content type.

overwrite.description: replace the destination if it already exists (default false)

path.description: destination file path, relative to the workspace root; parent directories are created

sha256.description: optional expected SHA-256 (64 hex characters); on mismatch nothing is written

source_url.description: https URL of the file to download. A signed, short-lived artifact URL (for example one supplied by the MCP client) works here. Only public https hosts are reached.

name: download_file

description: Apply several exact-text replacements to one file in a single atomic step and return a unified diff. Edits run in order and each sees the previous result. If any edit fails (old text missing or not unique), nothing is written. Use dry_run=true to preview the diff first.

dry_run.description: if true, only return the diff and leave the file untouched

edits.description: exact-text replacements applied in order; each needs old and new, and old must be unique unless replace_all is true

path.description: path to the file, relative to the workspace root

name: edit_file

description: Return metadata about a file or directory: size, modification time, and line count.

path.description: path to inspect, relative to the workspace root

name: file_info

description: Stage new, modified and deleted files under the given paths, or the whole workspace with all=true. Ignored files are never staged (no force option) and sensitive files such as .env or private keys are skipped and listed.

all.description: stage every change in the workspace when paths is empty

paths.description: files or directories to stage, relative to the workspace root

name: git_add

description: Commit the staged changes with the given message. Never amends, never runs repository hooks and never signs. Refuses when nothing is staged or when a sensitive file is staged. Check git_diff with staged=true first.

author_email.description: optional author email; defaults to git config user.email

author_name.description: optional author name; defaults to git config user.name

message.description: commit message: a subject line, optionally a blank line and a body

name: git_commit

description: Create a new local branch at HEAD or at start, optionally switching to it. Existing branches are never overwritten.

start.description: optional commit or branch to start from (default HEAD)

switch.description: switch to the new branch after creating it

name: git_create_branch

description: Show `git diff` for the workspace or one path, optionally staged, as a summary (stat), or against a ref. Read-only; external diff and textconv programs never run, and sensitive files are excluded.

path.description: optional file or directory, relative to the workspace root

ref.description: optional commit or branch to compare against, e.g. HEAD~1

staged.description: show staged changes (index vs HEAD) instead of unstaged ones

name: git_diff

description: Create a git repository at the workspace root (initial branch main unless given). Refuses when the workspace already is a repository.
name: git_init

description: Show recent commits, one line each (hash, date, author, subject), for the workspace or one path. Read-only.

limit.description: number of commits to show (default 20, max 200)

path.description: optional file or directory, relative to the workspace root

name: git_log

description: Show `git status --short --branch` for the workspace. Read-only; sensitive files are hidden.
name: git_status

description: Switch the workspace to an existing local branch. Git refuses when uncommitted changes would be overwritten; there is no force option, so no work is lost. Non-conflicting uncommitted changes are carried over.

name.description: existing local branch to switch to

name: git_switch_branch

description: Remove paths (or everything with all=true) from the staging area. The files in the workspace are not changed.

all.description: unstage everything when paths is empty

paths.description: files or directories to unstage, relative to the workspace root

name: git_unstage

description: Insert text before a 1-based line number. Use line = total_lines + 1 to append at the end.

line.description: 1-based line to insert before; use total_lines+1 to append

path.description: path to the file, relative to the workspace root

text.description: text to insert; a trailing newline is added if missing

name: insert_text

description: List files and directories inside the workspace, one level or recursively.

path.description: directory to list; omit or use . for the workspace root

recursive.description: walk the whole subtree instead of one level

name: list_files

description: List background processes started in this session with their status, readiness, PID, exit code and runtime.
name: list_processes

description: Create a directory (and any necessary parent directories) inside the workspace.

path.description: directory path to create, relative to the workspace root

name: mkdir_path

description: Move or rename a file or directory within the workspace.

from.description: source file or directory path, relative to workspace root

to.description: destination file or directory path, relative to workspace root

name: move_path

description: Read process stdout/stderr. Use after_seq with nextSeq from the previous response to fetch only new lines; omit it for the last tail_lines. Output is bounded by a per-process ring buffer.

after_seq.description: only return lines newer than this cursor; use nextSeq from the previous call

tail_lines.description: number of trailing lines when after_seq is 0 (default 100, max 1000)

timestamps.description: prefix each line with its time (default true)

name: process_logs

description: Read a text file. Returns numbered lines plus the raw content of the requested slice.

limit.description: maximum number of lines to return (default all)

path.description: path to the file, relative to the workspace root

name: read_file

description: Replace an inclusive range of 1-based lines with new content. Equivalent to delete_lines + insert_text in one atomic operation.

new_content.description: replacement text; replaces the entire line range

path.description: path to the file, relative to the workspace root

name: replace_lines

description: Replace an exact substring in a file. By default the old text must occur exactly once; set replace_all to replace every occurrence.

old.description: exact text to find (must be unique unless replace_all is true)

path.description: path to the file, relative to the workspace root

replace_all.description: replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match

name: replace_text

description: Stop a background process and start it again with the same command, working directory and environment.

timeout_seconds.description: graceful shutdown grace period in seconds (default 5)

name: restart_process

description: Run an allowlisted command inside the workspace root without a shell. Allowed prefixes: go test, go vet. Allowed exact commands (no extra arguments): bun run dev. Non-zero exit codes are reported in the result.

args.description: additional arguments appended to the command

command.description: command to run; must match an allowlisted prefix such as "go test"

timeout_seconds.description: optional timeout in seconds, capped by the server maximum

name: run_command

description: Search and replace a regular expression across all files in the workspace. Use dry_run=true to preview changes without writing.

dry_run.description: if true, show what would change without writing

max_files.description: maximum number of files to modify (default 50)

path.description: directory to search; omit for the workspace root

pattern.description: Go regular expression to search for

replacement.description: replacement string; supports $1, $2 for capture groups

name: search_and_replace

description: Search file contents with a regular expression and return matching paths with line numbers.

glob.description: optional glob filter on relative paths, e.g. *.go or **/*.go

max_results.description: maximum number of matches to return (default 100)

path.description: directory to search; omit for the workspace root

pattern.description: Go regular expression to search for

name: search_text

description: Start an allowlisted command as a long-lived background process inside the workspace root. It keeps running across tool calls, so use process_logs to inspect output and stop_process to end it. Commands never go through a shell. Allowed prefixes: go test, go vet. Allowed exact commands (no extra arguments): bun run dev.

args.description: additional arguments appended to the command

command.description: command to start; must match the same allowlist as run_command, e.g. "bun run dev"

cwd.description: optional working directory relative to the workspace root

env.description: optional environment variables; allowed keys: PORT, HOST, HOSTNAME, NODE_ENV, BUN_ENV, CI

name.description: optional process name (letters, digits, _ or -); generated when empty

wait_for_log.description: optional regular expression that must match process output before start returns

wait_for_port.description: optional TCP port that must accept connections before start returns

name: start_process

description: Stop every running background process. Useful for resetting workspace state before starting again.

timeout_seconds.description: graceful shutdown grace period in seconds (default 5)

name: stop_all_processes

description: Stop a background process and its children. Sends SIGTERM first and escalates to SIGKILL after the grace period. Set wait=false to return immediately.

timeout_seconds.description: graceful shutdown grace period in seconds (default 5)

wait.description: wait for exit before returning (default true); false signals and returns immediately

name: stop_process

description: Check the syntax of a file without running it. Go (.go) and JSON (.json) get a full parse; JavaScript (.js/.mjs/.cjs), TypeScript (.ts/.mts/.cts) and CSS (.css) get a delimiter check (balanced brackets, closed strings, template literals, regexes and comments). Other types return valid=true with check=none.

path.description: path to the file, relative to the workspace root

name: validate_syntax

description: Return aggregate statistics for the entire workspace: file counts, line counts, bytes, breakdown by extension, largest and most recently modified files.
name: workspace_stats

description: Create or overwrite a file with the given content. Parent directories are created automatically. Writes are atomic.

path.description: path to the file, relative to the workspace root

name: write_file
